sentences.english: Mr. Li has time on Friday.

sentences.simplified: 你想跟我一起吃饭，好不好？
sentences.traditional: 你想跟我一起吃飯，好不好？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ chī fàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
sentences.english: Do you want to eat together with me, okay?

sentences.simplified: 他的同事在那个餐厅工作。
sentences.traditional: 他的同事在那個餐廳工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóngshì zài nà ge cāntīng gōngzuò.
sentences.english: His coworker works at that restaurant.

sentences.simplified: 这家餐厅的牛肉面最好吃。
sentences.traditional: 這家餐廳的牛肉麵最好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de niúròumiàn zuì hǎochī.
sentences.english: This restaurant's beef noodle soup is the most delicious.

sentences.simplified: 谁要跟我们一起去吃晚饭？
sentences.traditional: 誰要跟我們一起去吃晚飯？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi yào gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù chī wǎn fàn?
sentences.english: Who wants to go eat dinner together with us?

sentences.simplified: 我下课以后五点半回来。
sentences.traditional: 我下課以後五點半回來。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàkè yǐhòu wǔ diǎn bàn huílái.
sentences.english: I'll come back at five thirty after class.

sentences.simplified: 我们星期六见，你的哥哥呢？
sentences.traditional: 我們星期六見，你的哥哥呢？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xīngqīliù jiàn, nǐ de gēge ne?
sentences.english: We'll meet on Saturday; and your older brother?

sentences.simplified: 那个餐厅怎么样？行不行？
sentences.traditional: 那個餐廳怎麼樣？行不行？
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge cāntīng zěnmeyàng? Xíng bù xíng?
sentences.english: How about that restaurant? Is it okay or not?
